page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed search page: $20 per 1,000 pages. Billed even when filters, duplicates or monitoring leave zero rows. Failed requests and unrecognized pages are not charged. Separate delivered-row fee applies. No start fee; proxy and compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option; before another page the budget must cover a page plus one row.

property.eventDescription: One delivered property: $2 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: id, zpid, listing_type, title, url, address, street, city, state, zipcode, price, price_text. Filtered, duplicate, unchanged or excluded rows have no row fee. Parsed pages cost $0.02 each, even with no delivered rows. No start fee; proxy and compute included. Stops at the maxTotalChargeUsd run-option budget.
